system.name: Vyomaraj Experience Engine
system.description: A configurable router for creative experience jobs, canonical agent categories, content modules, and visual-tool adapters.
system.scope_note: The source registry has 13 categories, 133 sub-agent counts, and 421 product counts. It contains only partial child names; unspecified names and sub-subagent relationships remain unspecified.

orchestrators.role: Continuity, handoff, unresolved-state tracking, and workflow coordination

agent_hierarchy.unknown_names_policy: Do not invent agent, sub-agent, or sub-subagent names. Surface count-only and partial rosters as unresolved.
agent_hierarchy.execution_note: This configuration describes routes; it does not claim that separate agent processes or RPC services are running.

controller.status: present; not invoked by this planner; live heartbeat not verified

device_manifest.status: present; not read or served by this planner; device and endpoint state not verified

existing_configuration_audit.review_note: This is a safe metadata inventory only. It does not invoke controllers, bootstrap scripts, device endpoints, or recovery workflows.

3d.label: 3D spatial experience
3d.definition: A spatial model or scene with a renderable viewpoint.

4d.label: 4D time-based experience
4d.definition: Project convention: a 3D scene plus a time-based sequence or animation; this is not asserted as a universal standard.

5d.label: 5D interactive experience
5d.definition: Project convention: a 3D/4D experience with interactive, contextual, accessibility, or multi-sensory design layers; owner review should define the intended dimensions. This is not asserted as a universal standard.

ar.label: AR experience
ar.definition: A spatial asset and presentation plan for an AR-capable target device; no device runtime is connected yet.

domain_routes.label: Food menu / dish visualization
domain_routes.route_note: FOOD is the supplied category. Individual child names and all product titles are not supplied.

domain_routes.label: Hotel menu / venue experience
domain_routes.route_note: No HOTEL category is present. FOOD + TOUR is a provisional mapping from the supplied category descriptions, not a newly named agent.

domain_routes.label: Automobile / car / bike configurator
domain_routes.route_note: No dedicated automotive or vehicle sub-agent is named in the canonical roster. Keep the job at the Vyomaraj/Jarvis studio layer until the owner assigns a category.

domain_routes.label: Fashion visualization
domain_routes.route_note: No dedicated fashion sub-agent is named in the canonical roster. Do not invent one.

domain_routes.route_note: BHAKTI + TOUR is a provisional mapping from supplied category descriptions. Require cultural/context review before release.

domain_routes.label: Tourism / place experience
domain_routes.route_note: TOUR is the supplied Tour and Travel category.

domain_routes.label: Educational interactive model
domain_routes.route_note: EDU is the supplied Education and World Wisdom category. Its roster is partial.

domain_routes.label: Trend-inspired content campaign
domain_routes.route_note: Use a user-supplied trend reference until a trend provider is configured. Adapt into original work; do not copy source assets. PLATFORM has one unmapped slot.

domain_routes.label: War / arms history visualization (non-operational only)
domain_routes.route_note: Historical or fictional, non-functional visualization only. No weapon construction, optimization, targeting, or operational configurator output.
